messages: #p304# from #m10002000# told me that she lost #b#t4001000##k a couple of days ago, on her way to #m10004000#. A monster covered in flames stole it! Fairies tend to obsess over glimmering, shiny objects, so she obviously wants it back... Time to go hunt some boars near #m10004000#.

I returned #t4001000# to #p304# in #m10002000#. I got lucky, finding it off a nasty #o30#. As a sign of gratitude, she gave me a fairy item. It's gorgeous and glimmers like a star. Maybe I can use this to make something special.
name: Arwen and the Glass Shoe
